title: API-5 deferred hardening: rate limiting + request/upload limits + tenant-isolation expansion + event streaming
body: Deferred from API-5 (plan section 18 Security/Event API). Add rate limiting, request/upload size limits, tenant-isolation expansion, and event streaming (SSE/WebSocket/AG-UI) on the read-only Event API. Existing controls (authn/authz, redaction, idempotency, CORS, path validation) are already verified.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend core/api_docs.py-style middleware layer and the existing read-only Event API (/api/v1/events, /api/v1/events/types, /api/v1/evidence/events) backed by core/events.py and core/event_bus.py. Add (1) a FastAPI middleware dependency for token-bucket rate limiting keyed by tenant + route class, (2) Content-Length / upload size guards via existing request-validation middleware, (3) tenant-isolation expansion by tightening model_strategy.py query scoping and adding tenant-scoped filters to the event bus, (4) event streaming via SSE first (Starlette EventSourceResponse) reusing core/event_bus.py subscriptions; WebSocket/AG-UI as optional stretch behind a feature flag. Reuse existing authn/authz/redaction/CORS/path-validation controls verbatim.
dependency_findings: REQUIRES core/events.py + core/event_bus.py + core/model_strategy.py (already present - reuse).
BI-PF-0336/0337/0338 are upstream API foundations - should be in done state.
conflict_findings: If BI-PF-0345 is concurrently active it may touch the same event API routes; assign or merge before starting.
No other listed item touches rate limiting middleware.
duplication_findings: BI-PF-0345 covers 'API-5: API hardening + event layer' at 0.46 similarity - verify whether 0345 is the parent or superseded; if 0345 already tracks the same hardening, link/merge rather than duplicate.
Existing authn/authz, redaction, idempotency, CORS and path-validation already verified per body - do NOT re-implement.
analysis.rationale: Reuse-first: existing event API + event_bus cover the data path; hardening is additive middleware/tenant-scoping. Classify EXTEND because no new component is needed - only route-level and middleware-level additions.
assumptions: FastAPI/Starlette middleware pipeline is the insertion point for rate/size limits.
Single-process or shared-cache deployment is acceptable for rate-limit counters initially.
Event Bus already supports pub/sub suitable for SSE fan-out.
risks: Rate-limiter state across multiple workers/processes may need shared store (Redis) - assumption to confirm.
SSE/WebSocket changes may conflict with existing idempotency/CORS middleware ordering.
AG-UI protocol spec may still be fluid - scope creep risk.
evidence: Existing event APIs /api/v1/events, /api/v1/events/types, /api/v1/evidence/events already serve read-only event data.
core/event_bus.py already exists as pub/sub backbone.
Body states existing controls are verified, implying test harness is in place.
missing_info: Is BI-PF-0345 a duplicate/parent? Merge decision needed.
Rate-limit SLOs: requests/min per tenant tier?
Target transport priority: SSE only, or SSE + WebSocket + AG-UI?
Shared rate-limit store available (Redis) in deployment topology?

context_review.reason: Existing event APIs and event_bus provide a solid reuse base; hardening is well-scoped middleware + scoping work. Only scope/dedup decisions are outstanding.
